classes.REAL_PROJECT_DATA: Raw dataset content: photos, sensor logs, labels, manifest fields.
classes.CURRENT_MODEL_OUTPUT: Verbatim output of an implemented project component (teacher CoE, retrieval, TS analyzer labels, baseline VLM).
classes.DERIVED_FROM_REAL_DATA: Statistics computed by video/scripts from raw data; reproducible.
classes.SYMBOLIC_KNOWLEDGE: Entities, edges, acceptance criteria from the frozen kb-v1 index or its source documents.
classes.INTENDED_SYSTEM_BEHAVIOR: Workflow the integrated WELDER system is designed to perform; not an experimental result.
classes.ILLUSTRATIVE_VISUALIZATION: Labels, layouts, or animations that carry no scientific claim.

disclosure: System vision demonstration using WELDER project data. Some reasoning and downstream capabilities illustrate intended system behavior.
